# Patrick Gordon

Patrick Gordon is a 16-year-old from Naas, Kildare, Ireland.

## Sports

- Former cross-country runner, competed with Naas Athletic Club (Naas AC)
- fromer Top 50 ranked tennis player in Ireland at U14 level, represented Naas CBS
- Football player for Naas AFC, he scored a goal for the Boys U16 team in a 2–0 victory for Naas AFC against Kilcock Celtic, he went on to score 10 goals in total that season.
